decision_question: Can satellite data delineate event-related change?
opening_criteria: Relevant post-event scene plus compatible baseline reproducible correction masks sensitivity and corroboration
prohibited_inference: Do not create or imply a flood polygon

decision_question: What regional precipitation accumulations accompanied the event?
opening_criteria: Acquire authenticated IMERG Late assets with identifiers and checksums or verified station observations with metadata
prohibited_inference: Do not state village-scale intensity or a design storm

decision_question: Which structures or assets were damaged?
opening_criteria: Geolocated privacy-safe ground records and audited receptor completeness
prohibited_inference: Do not allocate aggregate dwelling reports to building footprints

decision_question: Which drainage crossings controlled the reported impacts?
opening_criteria: Field-verified crossing or independently geolocated impact location
prohibited_inference: Do not call candidate outlets verified impact sites

decision_question: What were flood depth velocity and discharge?
opening_criteria: Event hydrograph or calibrated rainfall-runoff input channel geometry structures and calibration observations
prohibited_inference: Do not infer depth velocity discharge or return period
